name: ai-in-the-loop
label: AI-IN-THE-LOOP
title: AI in the loop: the person in control, the AI in support
summary: Natarajan, Mathur, Sidheekh, Stammer and Kersting contrast human-in-the-loop systems with AI-in-the-loop (AI²L) systems, where the human is in control of the system and the AI is there to support the human, and argue that evaluations should not judge the machine component alone.
quote: “We argue that existing evaluation methods often overemphasize the machine (learning) component's performance, neglecting the human expert's critical role.”
cite: Natarajan, Mathur, Sidheekh, Stammer and Kersting, “Human-in-the-loop or AI-in-the-loop? Automate or Collaborate?”, arXiv
